messages:
Alice W: Heads-up — noticed autoscaler jitter on dedicated GPU pools during the last canary. Looks correlated with async telemetry handoff delays from runtime -> controlplane.
Ben K: Can you paste a short timeline? is this when we switch shards?
Alice W: Timeline: request spike -> runtime emits headroom metrics -> controlplane receives ~12s later sometimes. Autoscaler window is 10s, so it flips between scale-up and scale-down.
Carla S: Yep seen that. We buffer telemetry in the runtime for acks, but network retries + operator backpressure sometimes add latency.
Dan R: Repro note: run loadgen with 100 r/s then drop to 10 r/s. Autoscaler immediately tears down warm nodes then tries to bring back. 30s tail is painful.
Erin (ML): Two options: (A) increase decision_window to > worst-case handoff latency (B) make decisions based on sliding median of last N samples to avoid spikes.
Frank G: Prefer B + short hysteresis. Increasing window helps but hurts responsiveness for real sustained changes. median(N) + min_hold_time seems sweet.
Gina L: Agree. Also think we should tag telemetry with a "source_epoch" so controlplane can detect delayed batches and ignore if stale.
Ben K: Nice — epoch + median sounds robust. How many samples for median? 3? 5?
Alice W: Proposal: median(3) over 10s sliding buffer + hold 20s after scale action. Default: decision_window: 10s, smoothing: median(3), hold_after_scale: 20s.
Carla S: Quick config sketch: 
```
autoscaler:
  decision_window: 10s
  smoothing: median(3)
  hold_after_scale: 20s
  stale_threshold: 15s  # drop metrics older than this
```
Dan R: +1 but set stale_threshold slightly > expected handoff worst-case. We saw 12s, so 15s OK but leave room.
Erin (ML): Also add emergent fastpath: if free_capacity < critical_threshold and burst_credits > 0 -> immediate scale-up ignoring median. That preserves tail-latency SLOs for latency-sensitive tenants.
Frank G: Good call. NeedGuard: ensure we don't drift by consuming credits on noisy spikes. limit per-minute credit spend.
Gina L: I'll add metrics: "autoscaler_decision_type" (median|fastpath|manual) and event tags for audit.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: autoscaler-config v2 -> staging at 1754443300 :rocket:
Ben K: After staging roll, let's run chaos tests with synthetic telemetry latency to validate no oscillation.
Alice W: I'll coordinate the test and post results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Erin (ML): If tests pass, follow-up RFC: split telemetry queueing into two paths (SLA vs batch) so critical metrics can get priority. That reduces tail latency without lengthening normal pipeline.
Carla S: That'd be a longer refactor but high ROI. Put it on the roadmap.
Alice W: Filed follow-up ticket — infra#1429. Closing thread for now.
